description: fails when the server job does not run in the deploy environment; the fix adds it to the job named after it rather than a duplicate

files..gitlab-ci.yml:
include:
  - project: "limenet/ci-cd-templates"
    ref: master
    file: "laravel/deploy.yml"
  - project: "limenet/ci-cd-templates"
    ref: master
    file: "laravel/sbom.yml"

stages:
  - build
  - deploy
  - sbom

variables:
  PHP_VERSION: "8.5"
  DEPLOY_HOST: "157.90.153.165"

deploy:
  extends:
    - .deploy_default_branch
  environment: production

sbom:php:
  extends:
    - .sbom_php

sbom:npm:
  extends:
    - .sbom_npm

sbom:server:
  extends:
    - .sbom_server
  variables:
    SBOM_SERVER_NAME: production
  environment:
    name: production
    action: prepare
